definitions.gloss: ... and go; ... away (movement away from the speaker)
definitions.explanation: Attached to the te-form of a verb, いく keeps its sense of movement away from where the speaker is: {持|も}っていく (to take something along), {歩|ある}いていく (to go on foot), {出|で}ていく (to go out, to leave). The verb before て says how the going happens.

definitions.gloss: go on ...ing; keep ...ing from now on
definitions.explanation: With verbs of change or continuing activity, 〜ていく describes a process that continues from the present onward: {寒|さむ}くなっていく (it will keep getting colder), {続|つづ}けていく (to keep on doing). Its mirror image is 〜てくる, which brings a change up to the present.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ていく。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧いきましょう。
⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧いった。
examples.english: My little brother left the room without saying a word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧ていく。
⟦これから→これから：01287_korekara⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧⟦{減|へ}っ→減る：01985_heru⟧ていくだろう。
examples.english: From now on the population will keep decreasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けていきたいです。
examples.english: I want to keep studying Japanese while working in Japan.

notes:
Formed from the te-form of a verb plus いく. The helper conjugates like ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: 〜ていきます, 〜ていった, 〜ていかない.

USAGE:
- Sense 1 pairs with 〜てくる: ⟦{持|も}っ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ていく (take) vs. ⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧ (bring); ⟦{連|つ}れ→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ていく (take someone along) vs. ⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧くる (bring someone along).
- Sense 2 looks forward from now: ⟦{変|か}わっ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ていく (will keep changing), ⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧ていく (will keep increasing), ⟦{生|い}き→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ていく (to go on living).

WATCH OUT:
- A change that has developed up to the present takes 〜てくる, not 〜ていく: ⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた (it has gotten warmer) vs. ⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧ていく (it will get warmer from now on).

WRITING:
- Usually written in kana as a helper; the kanji form ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ is common when the movement is literal (⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧).

RELATED WORDS:
- てくる: come ...ing; change up to now
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go
